text:
maya: quick sync — planning to onboard `novus-3.5-lite` into the model catalog TOMORROW 2026-03-18 at 10:00 PT. Target is hosted + dedicated pin. Need: smoke owner, canary %, rollback owner, and a short preflight checklist. estimate: 90m window.

aj: I can own smoke runs. will run the usual perf/latency/regen checks. +1 for 10:00 slot.

sasha: thanks — what quant/variant are we shipping? float16 or 4-bit? also confirm approx memory at inference.

maya: shipping q4_ggml (4-bit) variant; memory footprint ~6GB GPU usable (peak), kv cache optimized for short-context chat.

leo: for canary i propose 5% traffic for 30m then 25% for 30m if green. rollback owner: leo. i can watch metrics and cut if error rate or p99 latency regresses.

maya: sounds good. aj you OK to run smoke checklist and post results here? include these checks:
- basic generation sanity (3 prompts)
- latency p50/p95 against baseline
- tokenization/regression on canonical prompts
- cost-per-token sanity

aj: yep. i'll paste results in thread and link the smoke run doc.

infra-bot: Deploy slot reserve successful: `slot:d-042` reserved for novus-3.5-lite at 10:00 PT (duration 2h).

ops-bot: Reminder: add catalog pin and canary policy in PR. Use config snippet:```yaml
model: novus-3.5-lite
variant: q4_ggml
pin_slot: d-042
canary: 5%/30m -> 25%/30m
rollback: auto-fallback-to: novus-3.4
```

sasha: one more Q — does novus-3.5-lite require tokenizer updates? if yes, include tokenizer migration test in smoke.

maya: tokenizer compatible with current tokenizer pack. include 10 canonical prompts that caught subtle token splits in previous model. i'll upload them to the QA bucket before EOD.

aj: pinging @sasha in code review — will need review on catalog PR and the rollout policy. PR will be up by 07:30 PT tomorrow.

leo: if smoke fails, rollback plan: revert catalog pin + route traffic to novus-3.4 and scale up pools. ops on-call: @leo.

maya: short preflight checklist for tomorrow (assign owners):
- reserve slot (infra-bot) ✅
- PR for catalog + canary policy (maya/aj)
- unit tests + tokenizer tests (sasha)
- smoke run (aj)
- monitor dashboards up (leo)
- post-mortem template ready (maya)

aj: i'll take screenshots of latency graphs and post summary with timestamps. planning to run smoke in staging 08:30 PT. recording results. :thumbsup:

sasha: review PR tomorrow morning, will flag obvious regressions.

maya: final note — if everything is green at 11:30 PT we flip pin to dedicated and update pinned-version note in catalog. leave the canary window open for 2h after that for manual checks.

leo: noted. i'll keep an eye on p99 and error budget. if anything weird ping with the tag @oncall-eng.

aj: cool. see you all tomorrow. i'll drop the staging smoke logs here when done.

maya: thanks team — linking checklist doc: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/onboard-checklist/novus-3.5-lite (will update after AJ runs smoke).
